thread:
Jordan: FYI customer reports they clicked "Grant trial credits" in Support Console, UI showed success but account still 0 credits. customer=C-90122 email=test+trial2@acme.co
Maya: can you grab the request id / task id from the console network tab and timestamp?
Jordan: console shows grant_ref=gr_20260429_90122 req=req-4d5e6f ui_ts=2026-04-29T15:12:08Z
Jordan: network replied: 202 Accepted, body { "task": "task-2147", "status": "queued" }
Jordan: ledger query returned nothing for that customer (curl to billing ledgers gave empty entries)
Maya: that task id maps to GrantWorker. can someone share grant-worker logs for task-2147 from grant-worker-3?
grant-worker: 2026-04-29T15:12:10Z INFO starting task task-2147 for grant gr_20260429_90122
grant-worker: 2026-04-29T15:12:11Z ERROR GrantProcessor gr_20260429_90122 db error: SerializationFailure("could not serialize access due to concurrent update") attempt=1
grant-worker: 2026-04-29T15:12:12Z ERROR GrantProcessor gr_20260429_90122 db error: SerializationFailure attempt=2
grant-worker: 2026-04-29T15:12:13Z ERROR GrantProcessor gr_20260429_90122 attempts_exhausted, aborting, no ledger entry written
Sasha: looks like a transactional race. the console only surfaces the initial 202 and never follows the background status to the agent. so customer and agent see success but the grant never commits.
Maya: proposed fixes: (1) Support Console should poll /internal/tasks/{id} for final status for small grants (wait up to 10s) or show a clear "pending" state instead of "success". (2) GrantWorker needs better retry/backoff for SerializationFailure and must emit a metric when a task aborts without ledger write.
Eli: agree. also add server-side idempotency check: if console resubmits same grant_ref, either dedupe or surface conflict to agent.
Jordan: temporary workaround I performed: used billing-admin to create ledger entry manually so customer could proceed. curl we ran:

curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"customer_id":"C-90122","amount":15,"reason":"manual support grant"}' https://billing.internal/api/v1/ledgers/entries

=> 201 Created, customer got credits
Sasha: opening infra ticket INFRA-3198, assigning to @eli and @sasha. playbook: if task fails with SerializationFailure then auto-requeue with exponential backoff up to 5 attempts; if still failing mark task failed and alert grants-team; create a metric grants.worker.aborts and a pager threshold >3 in 5m.
Maya: I've filed UX item: CONSOLE-525 to change success state to "accepted (processing)" for async grants and add explicit "Confirm grant" button when task returns failed.
support-bot: Incident INC-6120 created for support-console-grant-silent-fail (linked INFRA-3198, CONSOLE-525)
Jordan: I've added logs + network captures to INFRA-3198 and updated the support case. customer notified and happy for now. :thumbsup:
Sasha: I'll prototype a quick console poller that checks task status for 8s and if failed, surface error + prefill a "force-create ledger entry" modal (requires reason + audit note). PR tomorrow.
Maya: keep thread open until INFRA-3198 remediation is merged. marking as P1 for self-serve signups.
Jordan: noted, closing loop on the case after remediation is in place.
